W_G0_reference.source: Daraszewicz et al. (2014), measured and ab-initio near-equilibrium anchors
W_G0_reference.interpretation: Lin's digitized low-Te value does not reproduce the Daraszewicz experimental G0 within its quoted 1-sigma range. The Lin value is itself extrapolated below 600 K; retain the discrepancy as a model/source limitation rather than rescaling the Lin curve.

timescale_at_reference_states.Cl_source: Tolias 2017 recommended solid-W White-Minges Cp and density fits; Cp is used as a narrow-range Cv proxy

synthetic_Ag_W_grid_smoke.purpose: Parameter-load, Ag-only source, two-phase interface exchange, and energy-ledger smoke check; not a physical pulse or MD trajectory.
synthetic_Ag_W_grid_smoke.interface_model: face-based unlike-phase transfer; equal-and-opposite; no sub-cell interface term
synthetic_Ag_W_grid_smoke.inactive_phase_lattice_temperature_input: NaN in empty-phase cells; finite values in active cells
synthetic_Ag_W_grid_smoke.test_source: 0.5 eV/ps to one Ag cell for 0.01 ps; then source off for 0.04 ps
limitations: No atoms or LAMMPS steps are used by this grid-only check.
The test pulse is reduced and numerical only; it does not set the physical pulse envelope or absorbed fluence.
Ag/W interface conductance is a provisional 1 GW m^-2 K^-1 sensitivity value, not an Ag/W measurement.
Full-size QSGS static acceptance and TTM-MD coupling remain outstanding.

provisional_Ag_W_electronic_interface.model: finite face-based electron conductance; equal-and-opposite interphase energy transfer
provisional_Ag_W_electronic_interface.source_basis: Li et al. (2024) Au/Pt and Au/Al method analogues; selected value is not a direct Ag/W measurement
provisional_Ag_W_electronic_interface.spatial_rule: unlike-phase fractions across shared grid-cell faces; sub-cell interface area omitted
provisional_Ag_W_electronic_interface.status: numerically implemented and smoke-tested; material value remains exploratory

limitations: The W Lin G curve below 600 K is extrapolated and differs from Daraszewicz's experimental G0; no empirical rescaling was applied.
The Ag Lin curves are digitized from plots; the low-temperature G plateau and short 5000–6607 K bridge are documented approximations.

Ag ke is a room-anchored Lin Drude closure; the user-provided 429 W m^-1 K^-1 anchor approximates total as electronic-dominated, and the A/B scattering ratio is inferred from XTANT's room-temperature channel split.
Ag ke high-Te nonequilibrium behavior is not independently validated; the raw XTANT kappa_tot table remains archived and is not used as the room-temperature amplitude.
Ag/W electron-interface conductance is set to a provisional 1 GW m^-2 K^-1 from non-Ag/W analogues; its material value and omitted sub-cell area are not validated.
The Ag/W solver is an exploratory Python reference bridge, not a compiled LAMMPS TTM fix; the gated atomistic driver has not run because no static structure passed.
No Ag lattice-conductivity curve or jointly validated Ag/W interface conductance is supplied.
The 0D energy pilot uses one normalized temporal Gaussian and tests energy accounting only; it is not the spatial laser calculation and does not test melting.
